instrument.name: Nine-Hole Peg Test
instrument.standard_primary_scoring: time from touching first peg until last peg returns to container

rmd.cost_description: RMD lists approximately USD 70-135 for commercially available standardized pegboards/kits.

apparatus.reason: RMD warns that pegboards differ and norms can change with board layout.

rights.basis: RMD Cost=Not Free is treated as equipment access, not a copyright determination. No authoritative explicit Public Domain/owner reproduction statement for protected manuals/forms was verified. Rawafid publishes an original timing/QC worksheet and paraphrased standardized procedure, not a vendor manual or third-party form.
